Maelor visibly clamps his existing book in its source hand against his torso for every frame; NEVER put it on his back, replace its cover/symbols, add straps or lose his dagger. Alistair keeps the same greatsword safely carried; Seraphine keeps the same veiled head, sage-green robe and lantern staff, including purple/gold identity accents. 4-9 seconds: the three settle into distinct listening weight shifts and small attention reactions. Alaric remains STANDING beside the throne on his original ground plane; retain his exact lion helmet, sword AND regal staff in their source hands. He acknowledges their presence with a subtle shoulder/head reaction compatible with holding both items. NEVER sit, spawn or receive a scroll/paper/document, replace a weapon with paper, hand anything over, rule, award, accept mission/gold or choose a route. 9-12 seconds: wind stirs banners and fabrics, torches flicker; the cast remains visibly alive and fully readable in the same wide composition before covered STATIC_TABLEAU transfer. No hidden cut, new actor/prop, identity change, axis crossing, 180-degree turn, world reset, cropped feet, speech, text, UI, combat, magic or audio.
